intent: Register ruff as a named Python lint row in check_commands and add it to DEFAULT_CHECKS so every compiled contract for this repository lints by default. Pinned in the locked environment via the reviewed policy-file flow; fails closed when unavailable. This ticket changes the compiler, so this contract is verified under pre-change defaults and the next compiled contract exercises the new default. All policy-owned Python is in scope: baseline lint findings are fixed inside the attempt, never suppressed, and the rule set is not weakened to force a pass. Evidence: mature production code shows zero findings, unlinted one-shot code shows hundreds.

requirements.LINT-PY-ROW: A named ruff check row exists in check_commands and exits nonzero on violations, mirroring the tach and pytest row shape.
requirements.LINT-PY-DEFAULT: The row is added to DEFAULT_CHECKS so every compiled contract for this repository runs it; per the compiler-change rule this contract itself is verified under the pre-change defaults and the next compiled contract exercises the new default.
requirements.LINT-PY-FAIL-CLOSED: When the pinned tool is unavailable the check fails rather than silently passing.
requirements.LINT-PY-PINNED: The ruff version and lint configuration are pinned in the locked environment via the reviewed policy-file flow, with file digests recorded in the contract review.
requirements.LINT-PY-SELF-PASS: Every policy-owned Python module passes the registered row at the ticket baseline under the adopted configuration, without weakening the rule set to force a pass; mechanical fixes land inside this attempt.
